eps.o: A bachelorette party is rescued from a sinking boat; a group of spring breakers is forced to pour out liquor; a man is caught selling beer from a backpack; a boiled peanut vendor drifts toward danger.
When caught with an open container in Florida, a woman lies about her age; officers ask a group of spring breakers to fill in a huge hole they dug on the beach; a man dressed like Rocky is stopped.

eps.t: Spring Break: Bombed at the Beach
eps.o: Test kits for illicit substances are handed out to beach goers; K-9 Delta conducts bomb detection drills on the sand; a man asks deputies to pose for a picture with his summons for underage drinking.
A man is caught illegally selling mixed drinks to spring breakers; a woman caught two days in a row drinking underage, claims she forgot to wash out her cup.
A swimmer in distress is rescued during spring break; Airbnb guests are evicted in Key West; a street performer tickles the ivories and blocks pedestrians; bikini-clad nurses are caught with booze.

A female shoplifting suspect in Independence, Missouri flees from Officers in a stolen box truck. She misses a turn and crashes into a retaining wall, sending two passengers to the hospital. A green Honda with an expired tag runs from Officers in Wichita, Kansas, circling a parking lot before giving up and apologizing. When a Deputy stops a driver for a seatbelt violation in Escambia County,…

West Covina Police chase a car seen leaving a known drug motel. The Officers notice the suspect on a video call and learn he was apologizing to his family for relapsing and not stopping for the Officers. Stockton, California Police are dispatched to a male burglarizing a store. The man runs in circles in a vain attempt to elude the Officers but eventually gives up. A Sergeant in West Covina…

West Covina Officers chase an Infiniti with a loud exhaust leaving a car meet. The driver admits he panicked when he saw the cops and didn't want his mom to be mad at him. A woman is pulled over while riding a stolen moped in Riverside County, California. She admits she borrowed it from a boyfriend and had no plan to return it. A man on probation in West Covina is found to be in possession of a…
A driver speeds off when asked to step out of his truck. Deputies learn a man with a warrant for fentanyl is hiding in a backyard. A suspect steals a portable speaker after threatening an employee
A suspect with an ATF warrant runs from a traffic stop and gets tased. Drones help locate stolen motorcycles in Fort Wayne. A suspect leaves behind soggy footprints when he bails from a stolen car.

A fleeing driver claims he was looking for companionship. A man admits to picking up a scantily clad lady and offering her $100 for her services. A man caught with meth claims he was set up by a girl.

West Covina Officers make contact with a suspicious person who questions whether they are 'the real police.' The man takes off running, and after a brief struggle, the suspect is tased to gain compliance. A black Mercedes that fled in Stockton, CA is found parked at an elementary school, and the driver has an excuse for everything. A Sedgwick County, KS Deputy finds meth in a purse during a…

Spike strips are used to deflate the tires of a stolen box truck. Pounds of meth and a tossed gun are recovered after a pursuit. A prior felon caught with a gun and cocaine claims he was being chased.
A stolen Dodge Ram 1500 crashes and knocks the power out. A woman caught huffing canned air in a stolen car keeps changing her story. A FLIR-equipped helicopter is used to catch fleeing juveniles.
A handcuffed passenger surprises officers by running from a traffic stop. A fleeing SUV runs out of gas shortly after a pursuit is terminated. A man claims guns were planted in his car.
Police pursue a car wanted in connection to a shooting. Stop Sticks end a chase involving a dually truck. Deputies help a suspect with a warrant by gathering his laundry before heading to jail.
A bicyclist with a warrant pedals into the desert to avoid deputies. Surveillance cameras identify suspects in a beer run. A man in love struggles with his girlfriend's addictive behavior.

A suspect fights with San Bernardino Officers and reaches for a waist pack before declaring that he has a gun concealed inside. A man with warrants pretends not to notice a Riverside County Deputy attempting to stop him for riding a bike with no lights and pedals into a backyard. A passerby calls Stockton Police when he sees a man push his girlfriend during a domestic dispute. Officers determine…
A suspect wanted for brandishing a knife squares up with officers. A passenger learns the hard way that a friend offered him a ride in a stolen Jeep. A young driver is caught with magic mushrooms.
Stop Sticks are used to end the pursuit of a known criminal. A stuck throttle is blamed for a motorcycle chase. A suspect with a screwdriver bolts. StarChase is used to track a fleeing Mercedes-Benz.

A man steals his girlfriend's truck when she refuses to take him to get methadone. A nervous driver flees when he shows a cop a picture of a gun. A Jeep gets spiked. Deputies PIT a freshly stolen car.

eps.t: Hot Pursuits:  Up, Up and Away
eps.o: A stolen motorcycle leads Deputies up a mountain. Deputies chase a stolen car driven by a thirteen year old. Kern County's Air Support Unit observes a fleeing suspect ditch his minibike.
A driver believes officers 'cheated' by using Stop Sticks to end a pursuit. A man making threats at a gas station is caught with his pants down. A suspect caught with meth claims he is a video judge.
In this Las Vegas Special, Officers pursue an armed suspect in a stolen car. A hit-and-run driver runs from his truck when it catches fire. An uncooperative driver hurls insults at Officers.
In this Las Vegas Special, the Air Unit and K-9 'Buddy' help capture a burglary suspect. Bystanders help German tourists out of a flipped car. A disgruntled woman shatters a patrol vehicle's window.

eps.t: Las Vegas: Fake It Till You Make It
eps.o: In this Las Vegas Special, A woman claims she was driving a stolen car to get to a birthday party. A sovereign citizen is caught with a fake plate. Tourists believe someone is hiding in their Airbnb.
A suspect accused of discharging a firearm is caught on a bus; a man caught with a stolen Kia claims the 'real driver' fled the scene; a man claims he punched a wall instead of his girlfriend.
A suspect driving a stolen car is caught with a fake U.S. Marshals vest and a toy gun. A scooter operator argues with Officers. A wheelchair-bound suspect offers donuts during an investigation.
A stolen motorcycle leads Deputies up a mountain after failing to lose them in town. A man argues with Officers that he made it home and can't be detained. A suspect is packing more than just meth.
Deputies PIT a freshly stolen Dodge Magnum. A man observed selling drugs hides a stolen gun in a wheel well. A man admits to having a problem when used balloons and a frozen NOS tank are recovered.
A man steals his girlfriend's truck when she refuses to take him to get methadone. A customer in Key West argues with his Russian girlfriend. A woman addicted to fentanyl steals her parent's truck.
Deputies chase a stolen car driven by a thirteen year old. A suspect complains when a security guard pepper-sprays him during a shoplifting attempt. A young woman admits to smoking crack cocaine.

Two scantily clad women fight in an area known for prostitution. A traffic stop in Florida turns into a drug investigation when meth is found in a purse. Deputies help capture an escaped Brahman bull.
Suspects wanted for diesel fuel thefts are caught at the pumps. A suspect known for concealing drugs under his belly and crotch is arrested. A man is shocked to learn he's been smoking fentanyl.
Star Chase is used to track a fleeing Mercedes-Benz in Alameda County. Open containers are found in a car during Spring Break. A driver takes his spray-painted jalopy to a car meet.
A suspect who fled on an unlicensed dirt bike begs to go home. A man with a warrant for domestic battery is caught with fentanyl.
Stop Sticks are used to end the pursuit of a man that Deputies have previously arrested. Two ghost guns are recovered during a traffic stop.
A driver who scrolled past a picture of a gun flees a traffic stop. A female burglary suspect crawls out of the basement on all fours.
When a blue Dodge Charger flees, the Air Support Unit takes over the pursuit; a man with a felony warrant ditches a crack pipe during his arrest; Deputies feed a suspect's puppy during an arrest.
A less lethal shotgun is used to gain compliance during a call for a man with a gun; a driver hides meth and fentanyl in a chocolate milk bottle; officers in Peoria, Ariz. respond to a house fire.
Kern County's Air Support Unit observes a fleeing suspect ditching his minibike; an online sex worker claims a client assaulted her; cocaine is found on a man causing a disturbance at a family party.

Stop sticks are used to end a pursuit of a Jeep in South Carolina; a suspect hides in a closet and fights with officers; a woman caught driving a stolen truck claims she has permission from the owner.
A suspect caught assaulting his girlfriend kicks in the witness's door. A man is stabbed in the head during an argument with neighbors.
A man fleeing from an illegal sideshow rams a patrol car; a fidgety driver with a meth pipe can't keep his hands out of his pockets; two women lie to deputies until a shard of meth reveals the truth.
A suspect hides in a crawl space; a father is maced when he confronts a man he catches peeping on his daughter; an argument over a broken television escalates.
Occupants of a car involved in a pursuit give conflicting stories. A woman claims she crashed a Tesla, but a USB drive reveals the truth. A woman argues the validity of a restraining order.

eps.t: Chilly With a Chance of Handcuffs
eps.o: A suspect claims to have broken into a truck to escape the cold; squatters in California provide a fake lease agreement; an outreach team connects unhoused individuals with housing and drug treatment.
A man fleeing from a stolen Honda has his hiding spot revealed by his loyal pet; a Veteran injured overseas struggles with addiction; a driver tells Deputies he started using meth during COVID.
A drug dealer discards a gun and is caught with a half pound of meth. A man refuses to identify himself and becomes combative when detained. A female passenger tosses a purse with a gun inside.
Officers with NYPD's 75th Precinct and drone operators with the Technical Assistance Response Unit (TARU) conduct a narcotics sting in Brooklyn.
NYPD Officers stop a teenager with a concealed gun; an angry mob in Brooklyn hogties a man caught breaking into a van.

eps.t: Car Chases: End of the Road
eps.o: The Air Unit tracks a speeding car. A fleeing SUV hits a dead end and slides down a hill. A suspect crashes and cries. A Grappler stops a chase. TVIs send cars spinning.
A teen ditches a gun. A tense takedown in a park. A suspect is tackled mid-sprint. A brawl over an unflushed toilet. A swampy manhunt. A fence-hopping foot pursuit.
A front-yard fight. An armed felon flees. A balcony brawl. A DV suspect hides. A nervous driver is tased. A bicyclist ignores commands. A cuffed suspect runs.
